Interest amount at the end of 1 year = (100x * 10 * 1)/100 = 10x
Total amount at the end of 1 year = 100x + 10x = 110x
Interest amount for the next 9 months = (110x * 10 * 9)/(100 * 12) = 33x/4

73x/4 = 1460
x = 80
Amount of money lent = 100x
= ₹8000

At the end of 1<sup>st</sup> year, the amount paid by the person = 16000 * (11/40) = Rs.4400
So, at the end of 3<sup>rd</sup> year, the required amount paid by the person:
(18400 - 4400) * (115/100)<sup>2</sup> = Rs.18515

t: P borrowed certain amount from bank at 20% SI for 2 years. At the same time, he lent the same amount to Q at same annual rate of compound interest for 2 years. In the process, P earns ₹1000, then find the borrowed amount by P.
e:
Let borrowed amount = 'x'
Interest amount given by P to bank = (x * 20 * 2)/100 = 0.4x
Interest amount received by P from Q = x * [1.2<sup>2</sup> - 1] = 0.44x
According to the question:
0.44x - 0.4x = 1000
x = 25000
Hence, borrowed amount by P = ₹25000
h: P ने बैंक से 2 वर्षों के लिए 20% साधारण ब्याज पर कुछ धनराशि उधार ली। समान समय पर उसने Q को समान धनराशि चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज की समान वार्षिक दर पर 2 वर्ष के लिए उधार दी। इस प्रक्रिया में, P ₹1000 कमाता है, तो P द्वारा उधार ली गई धनराशि ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: Rohan borrowed Rs. 60000 at 20% per annum compounded half-yearly for 1(1/2) years. If he paid Rs. 45000 at the end of one year, then how much amount of money he paid at the end of 1(1/2) years?
e:
P = Rs. 60000
R = 21% per annum
T = 3/2 years
Amount after 1 year = 60000 * (1 + 20/200)<sup>2</sup> = Rs. 72600
He paid Rs. 45000
So, left amount = 72600 - 45000 = 27600
So, amount paid at the end of 1(1/2) years = 27600 * (1 + 20/200) = Rs. 30360

repaid =5000

At end of 3rd year, 6000×11/10×11/10=7260

t: A person borrows ₹28,400 at 15% per annum compound interest, compounded annually. At the end of each year, he pays ₹9,100 as partial payment. How much balance is still due on him after two such installments?
e:
Look only at the units (ones) digit of each option:
(a) ₹17,817 → ends in 7; (b) ₹17,973 → ends in 3; (c) ₹17,795 → ends in 5; (d) ₹17,994 → ends in 4.
The exact value works out to ₹17,994 (see Solution 2), ending in 4 — only option (d) shares that units digit, so it is the only one that can be correct; the other three are eliminated on sight.

After Year 1: 28400×1.15 = 32,660; balance after payment = 32660-9100 = ₹23,560
After Year 2: 23560×1.15 = 27,094; balance after payment = 27094-9100 = ₹17,994 → option (d).
h: एक व्यक्ति 15% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर ₹28,400 उधार लेता है, जिस पर ब्याज वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है। प्रत्येक वर्ष के अंत में, वह आंशिक भुगतान के रूप में ₹9,100 चुकाता है। ऐसी दो किश्तों के बाद भी उस पर शेष बकाया कितना है?

t: A savings scheme offers compound interest annually. A woman deposits ₹10,000. At the end of the first year, the interest rate is 10%. In the second year, due to inflation, the interest rate rises to 12.5%, and in the third year, it drops to 8%. Calculate the total interest she earned at the end of 3 years.
e:
Combined growth factor = 1.10 × 1.125 × 1.08 = 1.3365. Amount = 10000 × 1.3365 = 13,365. CI = 13365-10000 = ₹3,365.

After year 1: 10000×1.10 = 11,000. After year 2 (12.5%): 11000×1.125 = 12,375. After year 3 (8%): 12375×1.08 = 13,365. CI = 13365-10000 = ₹3,365. Multiplying the three growth factors together (Method 1) gives the same result faster than three separate year-by-year steps.
h: एक बचत योजना वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज देती है। एक महिला ₹10,000 जमा करती है। पहले वर्ष के अंत में ब्याज दर 10% है। दूसरे वर्ष, मुद्रास्फीति के कारण, ब्याज दर बढ़कर 12.5% हो जाती है, और तीसरे वर्ष यह घटकर 8% हो जाती है। 3 वर्षों के अंत में उसे कुल कितना ब्याज मिला, इसकी गणना कीजिए।

t: Mukund deposits ₹57,000 in a bank at compound interest. The rate of interest is 10% p.a. for the first year and increases by 3% in the second year. What is the compound interest (in ₹) obtained in 2 years?
e:
Year 2 rate = 10%+3% = 13%. Combined growth factor = 1.10 × 1.13 = 1.243. Amount = 57000 × 1.243 = 70,851. CI = 70851-57000 = ₹13,851.

After year 1: 57000 × 1.10 = 62,700. After year 2 (rate 13%): 62700 × 1.13 = 70,851. CI = 70851 - 57000 = ₹13,851. Note: "increases by 3%" means the new rate is 10+3=13%, not a 3% increase on the rate itself — a common trap in this question type.
h: मुकुंद ने ₹57,000 बैंक में चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर जमा किए। पहले वर्ष ब्याज दर 10% वार्षिक है और दूसरे वर्ष में यह 3% बढ़ जाती है। 2 वर्षों में प्राप्त चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज (₹ में) कितना होगा?

Quarterly compounding at 1% per quarter for 4 quarters gives roughly 4% growth plus a small compounding bonus, landing just above 10,400 — matching option (a).

Rate per quarter = 4%/4 = 1%. Amount = 10000×(1.01)⁴ = 10000×1.040604 ≈ 10406.
